title: TSRNet: A Lightweight Thermal Saliency Refinement Network for Tiny Human Detection
authors: Vidhan Jain, Tanish, Sobhan Kanti Dhara
summary: A small saliency network that makes faint thermal signatures easier to see. It reaches 0.454 mAP@0.5 on RGBT TinyPerson, 5.5% above prior detectors, at only 36.5 GFLOPs. Two new modules do the heavy lifting: Dual-Frequency Refinement and Axial Context Pooling.

title: SAPNet: A Lightweight and Efficient Saliency-Aware Path Network for Tiny Human Detection in Thermal Aerial Imagery
authors: Vidhan Jain, Tanish, Sobhan Kanti Dhara
summary: Built for drones and other small, power-limited platforms: 0.404 mAP@0.5 with just 3.4M parameters and 20 GFLOPs. Saliency-path and channel-reweighting modules keep subtle heat signatures from getting lost as features are merged across scales.

title: GeoStatNet: Geometric-Statistical Feature Fusion for Robust Ship Detection in Degraded Maritime Environments
authors: Tanish, Vidhan Jain, Sobhan Kanti Dhara
summary: Finding ships when the sea, haze and clouds are working against you, by fusing geometric and statistical cues.

title: GFCR-Net: Gradient-Guided and Frequency-Gated Context Refinement for Robust Ship Detection in Complex Optical Remote Sensing Images
authors: Tanish, Vidhan Jain, Sobhan Kanti Dhara
venue: IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters (GRSL)
summary: Uses image gradients and frequency information to decide which surrounding context actually helps a ship detector, and which is just clutter.

title: Frequency-Aware Feature Refinement and Auxiliary Mask Supervision for Tiny Human Detection in Aerial Thermal Images
authors: Pratyush Sahu, Vidhan Jain, Sobhan Kanti Dhara
venue: IEEE India Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (InGaRSS)
summary: Adds frequency-aware refinement and an extra mask-based training signal so the detector learns where tiny people actually are.

title: Cross-Scale Correlation Guided Attention Network for Robust Tiny Human Detection in Aerial Thermal Imagery
authors: Vidhan Jain, Pratyush Sahu, Sobhan Kanti Dhara
summary: Uses correlations between feature scales to guide attention toward the few pixels that belong to a person.

title: Tiny Human Detection from Aerial Infrared Sensor Imagery via Lightweight Center-Surround Context-Aware Framework
authors: Vidhan Jain, Pratyush Sahu, Tanish, Sobhan Kanti Dhara
summary: Borrows the center-surround idea from how our own eyes pick out small objects, in a lightweight detector for infrared imagery.
